section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations of the present study, highlighting its cross-sectional nature and the inability to infer causation. It also addresses potential biases from using crowdsourcing marketplace samples, the representativeness of the US population, and the mean BMI of the sample falling into the overweight category. Furthermore, the section critiques the measures of sexual liberalism and body image (BI-AAQ, BASES-AP) used, noting their potential limitations and the small amount of variance accounted for by positive body image in the regression analyses.
